eligible_response_oracle: NFR-02 latency does not score search relevance. Count an eligible search request as successful when the HTTP response completes with the expected success status; failures/timeouts remain denominator violations. NFR-04 separately evaluates Success@5 using reviewed relevance labels.
latency_boundary_proposal: client HTTP call start through full response body, including connection setup; image bodies excluded
clock_method_approval: Use a monotonic clock for elapsed durations; UTC is event metadata. Suraj confirmed this rule on 2026-11-03. Binary provenance and implementation verification remain pending.
quantile_method_proposal: R7 over actual samples; no pooled averages of per-run percentiles
denominator: all issued eligible indexed search requests; unexpected failures/timeouts are violations
dependencies: validated final corpus and measured path
note: Static workload profiles contain draft choices only. Local pilot does not approve or fill these real-run values.
